data.name: Sharwishi
data.gender_notes: Sharwishi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharwishi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shri' which means wealth and 'Vishi' which means knowledge. This name is for a girl who is believed to be blessed with both wealth and knowledge, making her a powerful and prosperous individual. The name Sharwishi carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharwishi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharwishi is a name that invokes the blessings of the Goddess Lakshmi, who is the deity of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism. This name is believed to bring good fortune, happiness, and success in all areas of life.
data.etymology: Sharwishi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwishi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
